content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Philippine Star's PostPhilippine Star Verified account2d · Shared with PublicBIGBANG WORLD TOUR BEGINS IN AUGUST 2026! G-Dragon announced at Coachella that BIGBANG's world tour will begin this August, marking their 20th anniversary. “This is just the beginning. So, we got something special to announce for the first time right here at Coachella. BIGBANG’s 20th anniversary world tour will begin this August,” the K-pop star said. BIGBANG officially debuted on August 19, 2006 under YG Entertainment.
